name: Hagar
overview: The Scriptures reveal Hagar as an Egyptian servant of Sarah who was given to Abraham to bear a child on Sarah's behalf, as seen in Genesis 16:1 and 16:3. God met Hagar in her distress in the wilderness, affirming His awareness and care for her (Genesis 16:7, 16:13). Through Hagar, God promised a fruitful lineage, blessing her son Ishmael to become a great nation with twelve princes (Genesis 17:20). The narrative highlights God's sovereign provision and faithfulness even in complex human situations.
